t: For fixing toilets or bidets into solid base material. Can be used without expansion plug to fix into wooden floors. Special plastic bushes on plug to ensure no damage is done to the sanitaryware during installation.
b: Contents: Nylon Plugs 8mm (2), Stud Screws 6 x 70mm (2), Plastic Bushes 12 x 10mm (2), Silver Raised Caps (2) & White Raised Caps (2)
